topics.title: Radio Hosts Discuss Sexual Enhancement Drugs
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, hosts discuss various methods of sexual enhancement including injections and pills. topics.title: Ski Mishap and Supermodel Debate
topics.summary: A skier crashes into a tree for an unknown reason, followed by a discussion about whether a woman named Carol is truly a supermodel due to her perceived lack of recognition compared to Cheryl Teiggs; the hosts ultimately conclude she was overshadowed.

topics.title: High School Radio & Joe Frazier's Troubles
topics.summary: Students argue about listening to radio in their private lounge, leading to discussions of student rights and a bizarre conversation involving celebrity anecdotes. Howard interviews former boxer Joe Frazier who blames high blood pressure for erratic driving and his toe injury while discussing romantic feelings and personal stories before shifting to news including the representation of 'Crackhead Bob' and Fred the Elephant Boy.

topics.title: David Cassidy Discusses New Album and Directing Challenges
topics.summary: During an interview, David Cassidy discusses his upcoming album of updated Partridge Family songs. He admits difficulty managing himself while directing the project, expressing enjoyment in re-recording three tracks like "I Think I Love You" and acknowledging potential sales goals despite being 80 years old.
